lines: Har ek baat pe kehte ho tum ke tu kya hai?
couplets.en: At every word you ask me what I am.

lines: Har ek baat pe kehte ho tum ke tu kya hai?
Tumhi kaho ke ye andaaz-e-guftagu kya hai?
couplets.en: At every word you ask me what I am, so tell me, what kind of conversation is this?

lines: Har ek baat pe kehte ho tum ke tu kya hai?
couplets.en: At every word you ask me what I am.

lines: Jala hai jism jahaan, dil bhi jal gaya hoga
couplets.en: Where the body burned, the heart must have burned too.

lines: Jala hai jism jahaan, dil bhi jal gaya hoga
Kuredte ho jo ab raakh, justuju kya hai?
couplets.en: The heart must have burned with the body, so what are you looking for now in the ashes?

lines: Har ek baat pe kehte ho tum ke tu kya hai?
couplets.en: At every word you ask me what I am.

lines: Na shole mein ye karishma, na barq mein ye ada
couplets.en: The flame has no such magic, nor lightning such grace.

lines: Na shole mein...
Na shole mein ye karishma, karishma...
couplets.en: Even the flame has no such magic.

lines: Na shole mein ye karishma, na barq mein ye ada
Koi bataao ke woh shokh-e-tund-khu kya hai?
couplets.en: If flame has no such magic and lightning no such grace, what are we to make of that fiery beloved?

lines: Har ek baat pe kehte ho tum ke tu kya hai?
couplets.en: At every word you ask me what I am.

lines: Har ek baat pe...
couplets.en: At every word...

lines: Ragon mein daudte phirne ke hum nahin qaayal
couplets.en: I put little faith in blood that merely runs through the veins.

lines: Ragon mein daudte phirne ke hum nahin qaayal
Jab aankh hi se na tapka, to phir lahu kya hai?
couplets.en: What does it matter that blood runs through the veins if it never falls from the eye?

lines: Har ek baat pe kehte ho tum ke tu kya hai?
Har ek baat pe...
couplets.en: At every word you ask me what I am.

lines: Rahi na taaqat-e-guftaar, aur agar ho bhi
couplets.en: The strength to speak is gone, and even if it were still mine...

lines: Rahi na taaqat-e-guftaar, aur agar ho bhi
To kis ummeed pe kahiye ke aarzoo kya hai?
couplets.en: Even if I still had the strength to speak, what hope would I have in telling you what I long for?

lines: Har ek baat pe kehte ho tum ke tu kya hai?

couplets.en: At every word you ask me what I am, so tell me, what kind of conversation is this?

lines: Har ek baat pe...
couplets.en: At every word...

lines: Hua hai shah ka musaahib, phire hai itraata
Hua hai shah ka, shah ka, shah ka musaahib
couplets.en: He struts about now that he keeps the king company.

lines: Hua hai shah ka musaahib, phire hai itraata
Wagarna shehar mein Ghalib ki aabroo kya hai?
couplets.en: He struts because he keeps the king company, for what standing would Ghalib otherwise have in this city?
